application_rules: Verify exact base byte hash before loading.
Keep every existing ID and its original axis. Preserve original legacy document bytes.
Reject duplicate IDs, alias collisions across distinct meanings, cycles, missing parents and unexpected base IDs.
Apply the ten proposed additions and explicit definition overlays only in a separate draft namespace.
Existing companies keep old tags as broad hypotheses. Parent membership never implies child membership. Child assertions require company evidence.
No ID is merged, deleted, activated or applied to company records by this patch.
After expert approval, record approval hash and compile a new effective ontology; write a total identity migration for all unchanged IDs and new-ID additions.
Legacy IDs lacking authored boundaries remain definition_status=legacy_unreviewed; usable in control/exploration only, never sufficient concrete-activity support for v3 operating peers.
